title: Size bound after hardwiring left inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m+n$ input bits, and fix an assignment to its first $m$ inputs. The size of the resulting circuit, defined as its number of input bits plus its number of gates, is at most the size of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns Boolean values to the first $m$ inputs
